hostname ix-q01
!
ip access-list acl-q-biz permit ip src 192.0.2.0/24 dest 198.51.100.0/24
!
ip access-list qos-d1 permit ip src any dest any dscp 46
!
class-map match-any cm-q-biz
  match ip access-list acl-q-biz
class-map match-any cm-q-voice
  match ip access-list qos-d1
!
policy-map pm-q-child
  class cm-q-voice
    priority percent 20
  class cm-q-biz
    bandwidth percent 40
  class class-local
  class class-default
policy-map pm-q-lan
  class cm-q-biz
    set ip dscp 18
  class class-local
  class class-default
!
ip route default 203.0.113.2
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  ip address 203.0.113.1/30
  service-policy enable
  service-policy output pm-q-child
  traffic-shape rate 10000000
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0
  ip address 192.0.2.1/24
  service-policy input pm-q-lan
  no shutdown
!
